scope: Reference source behavior, not traced live Arch kernel execution
initial_sid: Reference pre-policy exec assigns SECINITSID_INIT; security_sid_to_context translates INIT to kernel before initial load. Candidate capability userspace_initial_context and SID init context select Linux init_t; observed kernel string alone cannot identify actual numeric SID.
nnp: Reference check_nnp_nosuid checks process2 nnp/nosuid permissions when capability enabled, or bounded SID fallback. Explicit exec context fails on refusal; automatic transition may retain old SID. Enforcing effect not tested live.
